content:
The best marketing strategy might be the one with the highest ROI.

Be10x sponsored the Afghanistan cricket team jersey at nearly 1/10th the cost of an Indian jersey, while gaining massive impressions and visibility.

That’s not just marketing.

That’s capital-efficient marketing.

Be10x became the first bootstrapped startup to sponsor a national cricket team jersey, and is now the official AI partner of the Afghanistan Cricket Board.

The interesting part?

Two years ago, the co-founders shifted their focus from marketing & sales to building a great product and delivering results.

Then word of mouth became the growth engine.

Less dependence on paid marketing ➡️ stronger organic growth ➡️ hyperscaling ➡️ bigger strategic bets.

Sometimes, the smartest marketing move isn’t spending more.

It’s making every rupee work harder.
